# V7 Autonomous Model Function Graph Appendix

Source consolidation: `docs/reports/research/V7_AUTONOMOUS_MODEL_KNOWLEDGE_CONSOLIDATION.md`.

This appendix is the exhaustive static function graph audit for the original Step 1C code scope. It is read-only evidence: no Runtime, Planner, Authority, production, timer, deploy, or user movement was modified.

Scope note: `tests/unit/test_omp_document_index.py` appeared after the first Step 1C snapshot and is excluded from this appendix to preserve the originally reported audit baseline.

## Audit Totals

- Files discovered in scope: `225`
- Function/class nodes indexed: `3438`
- Systemd units indexed: `13`
- Static call/systemd edges indexed: `24819`
- Mutation-capable nodes detected: `820`
- Read-only/advisory nodes detected: `1202`
- Orphan/stub/dormant/read-only-orphan nodes detected: `114`

## Closure Legend

- `CLI_ENTRYPOINT`: externally invoked CLI `main` or script entrypoint.
- `MUTATION_CLOSED`: function has write/subprocess/mutation behavior and static downstream or owner closure.
- `READ_ONLY_CLOSED`: read-only/advisory node with caller or downstream closure.
- `READ_ONLY_ORPHAN`: read-only/advisory node without proven downstream closure.
- `LOGIC_CLOSED`: supporting function with both inbound and outbound edges.
- `LEAF_CLOSED`: function consumed by another function and not calling indexed nodes.
- `ENTRY_LOGIC_PARTIAL`: entry/helper with outgoing calls but no static inbound caller.
- `STUB_OR_DORMANT`: pass/TODO/future/placeholder/dormant evidence detected.
- `ORPHAN_UNLINKED`: no static caller and no static downstream indexed call.
- `TEST_ONLY`: test-only node.
